description: Data that pi-ai-anthropic migrated from the sealed Model packages. The sources are read-only; nothing imports them.

sources.migrated: the 4 models, the parameter subset (drops become unsupported, efforts low to max), the user reminder role, the 1h last-message cache, capabilities and limits with every upstream value unknown, and the 4194304-byte image limit

the whole-group item rule: format anthropic-claude-v1, signed reasoning.text, reasoning.encrypted data not empty and not [REDACTED]; the signed-prefix models (claude-opus-5.5 and claude-fable-5.1) are not migrated: by the project convention no record turns reasoning off, and live on 2026-10-22 the gateway took a foreign tool turn with reasoning on, and both models refused reasoning off; the frozen original meter is not migrated; the sealed method name `anthropic-complete-signed-encrypted-output-zero-framing-estimated/1` (ANTHROPIC_REPLAY_REVISION, lines 13-14) and the whole-group condition of classifyAnthropicReasoning (lines 157-196), which the meter sees as the units the codec wrote `reasoning_details` for

the claude.json estimate of the NFKC JSON of messages and tools with [image] placeholders, the SHA-256 check of claude.json, the 28-pixel patch rule and the four image media types; encode(..., 'all') is not migrated (special tokens stay inactive), nor data URL decoding, image-size and the MIME check
the cache read and write deduction from the prompt and the unknown negative remainder with its diagnostic; cost is not migrated
the function tool subset: the parameters schema is an object
the cache rule as record data (last message, ttl 1h); the engine places the marker; marker removal and L02 are not migrated

the complete-output-group method: a whole unit that carries reasoning state is counted once as the upstream output tokens O of the call that produced it, O already including reasoning; the refusals when O is unknown, when reasoning exceeds output, or when the counting combination of the source differs. The private observation protocol, replaySelection and the caller-carried responses are not migrated: the numbers come from the dispatch records of the model runtime through the preparation lease

the complete envelope difference: the new units are counted as count(envelope + new units) - count(envelope + []) with the tools left out of the envelope, and added to the real input total of the continued call as an estimate

tests.target: tests/support/legacy-cases.ts, tests/fixtures (the negative input remainder only)
tests/meter.spec.ts (the projected text and the reference count 150, inline)

sealedRevisions.note: Every current record starts at revision 1. The sealed revisions and the frozen original meter (definition 3, mp4-17) are not migrated: the digest of the new record format cannot equal a sealed adoption, so no sealed revision resolves exactly.
